report:
Breast, right, wide local excision

The specimen consists of a right wide local excision specimen (30 g, 45 x 40 x 30 mm). Sectioning reveals a firm, well-circumscribed, lobulated tumour measuring 32 mm in greatest dimension (32 x 30 x 25 mm) in the lower outer quadrant (8 o'clock), 0 mm from the anterior margin. The remaining breast tissue is fibrofatty and unremarkable.

(1-5) tumour with the anterior margin.
(6-9) posterior, superior, inferior and lateral margins.
(10) medial margin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision (less than total mastectomy)
- Specimen laterality: Right
- Tumour site: Lower outer quadrant (8 o'clock)
- Tumour size: Greatest dimension 32 mm (32 x 30 x 25 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Phyllodes tumour, benign
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a fibroepithelial tumour measuring 32 mm with leaf-like fronds lined by a bland bilayered epithelium and mild stromal cellularity, mild stromal atypia and no stromal overgrowth; mitoses number 2 per 10 high power fields. Subepithelial stromal condensation is present beneath the leaf-like fronds, and the epithelium retains its myoepithelial layer. The border is circumscribed and pushing. No malignant heterologous element is seen. The features are those of a benign phyllodes tumour.
- Stromal cellularity: Mild (stromal nuclei are non-overlapping)
- Stromal atypia: Mild (minimal variation in nuclear size, even chromatin, and
  smooth nuclear contours)
- Stromal overgrowth: Absent
- Mitotic rate: 2 per 10 high power fields
- Histologic tumour border: Circumscribed (well-defined; pushing)
- Malignant heterologous elements: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Epithelial component: Bland bilayered epithelium

Surgical margins
- Anterior margin: Involved by tumour
- Posterior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: 6 mm
- Superior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Inferior margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Medial margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: greater than 10 mm
- Lateral margin: Uninvolved by tumour, closest distance: 4 mm

Regional lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: No lymph nodes submitted or found

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not applicable

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: Not applicable (benign phyllodes tumour; AJCC staging applies to
  malignant phyllodes tumour only)

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Not identified

BREAST, right, wide local excision
- BENIGN PHYLLODES TUMOUR, 32 mm; anterior margin involved; other margins clear
  (closest 4 mm, lateral); see synoptic report
